description: This Recherche Data Gouv release contains multi-technique measurements from a removable urban pavement with a functionalized surface tested on Gustave Eiffel University’s fatigue carousel in Nantes, France. The article and repository describe aerial drone views, pedestrian-height smartphone images and stepped-frequency radar measurements aimed at identifying surface and subsurface anomalies. The public version lists one Experimental_RUP-FS_Database.zip archive of about 3.7 gigabytes and English and French readmes. The repository states the French Etalab 2.0 open licence, with free public access. This is a test structure and controlled loading setting, not a survey of ordinary roads or proof of utility-network performance. One pavement system, chosen sensor positions and imposed fatigue conditions are limitations for transferring a damage detector to other street types. A reviewer-assessed use is testing a pavement-condition observation layer before simulating access or maintenance decisions. No directly comparable existing catalogue record was identified. The archive and readmes were not downloaded. Coverage is one Nantes fatigue-carousel pavement, and the related catalogue search found no exact measurement counterpart.
